text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ

translations.asad: ABOUT WHAT do they [most often] ask one another?
translations.sahih: About what are they asking one another?

translations.asad: About the awesome tiding [of resurrection],
translations.sahih: About the great news -

translations.asad: on which they [so utterly] disagree.
translations.sahih: That over which they are in disagreement.

translations.asad: Nay, but in time they will come to understand [it]!
translations.sahih: No! They are going to know.

translations.asad: And once again: Nay, but in time they will come to understand!
translations.sahih: Then, no! They are going to know.

translations.asad: HAVE WE NOT made the earth a resting-place [for you],
translations.sahih: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

translations.asad: and the mountains [its] pegs?
translations.sahih: And the mountains as stakes?

translations.asad: And We have created you in pairs;
translations.sahih: And We created you in pairs

translations.asad: and We have made your sleep [a symbol of] death
translations.sahih: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

translations.asad: and made the night [its] cloak
translations.sahih: And made the night as clothing

translations.asad: and made the day [a symbol of] life.
translations.sahih: And made the day for livelihood

translations.asad: And We have built above you seven firmaments,
translations.sahih: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]

translations.asad: and have placed [therein the sun,] a lamp full of blazing splendour.
translations.sahih: And made [therein] a burning lamp

translations.asad: And from the wind-driven clouds We send down waters pouring in abundance,
translations.sahih: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water

translations.asad: so that We might bring forth thereby grain, and herbs,
translations.sahih: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation

translations.asad: and gardens dense with follage.
translations.sahih: And gardens of entwined growth.

translations.asad: VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] has indeed its appointed time:
translations.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا

translations.asad: the Day when the trumpet [of resurrection] is sounded and you all come forward in multitudes;
translations.sahih: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

translations.asad: and when the skies are opened and become [as wide-flung] gates;
translations.sahih: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways

translations.asad: and when the mountains are made to vanish as if they had been a mirage.
translations.sahih: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

translations.asad: [On that Day,] verily, hell will lie in wait [for those who deny the truth] –
translations.sahih: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

translations.asad: a goal for all who are wont to transgress the bounds of what is right!
translations.sahih: For the transgressors, a place of return,

translations.asad: In it shall they remain for a long time.
translations.sahih: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

text.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا

translations.asad: Neither coolness shall they taste therein nor any [thirst-quenching] drink –
translations.sahih: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink

translations.asad: only burning despair and ice-cold darkness:
translations.sahih: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

translations.asad: a meet requital [for their sins]!
translations.sahih: An appropriate recompense.

translations.asad: Behold, they were not expecting to be called to account,
translations.sahih: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

translations.asad: having given the lie to Our messages one and all:
translations.sahih: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

translations.asad: but We have placed on record every single thing [of what they did].
translations.sahih: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

translations.asad: [And so We shall say:] "Taste, then, [the fruit of your evil doings,] for now We shall bestow on you nothing but more and more suffering!"
translations.sahih: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

translations.asad: [But,] verily for the God-conscious there is supreme fulfilment in store:
translations.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

translations.asad: luxuriant gardens and vinyards,
translations.sahih: Gardens and grapevines

translations.asad: and splendid companions well matched,
translations.sahih: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age

translations.asad: and a cup [of happiness] overflowing.
translations.sahih: And a full cup.

text.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا

translations.asad: No empty talk will they hear in that [paradise], nor any lie.
translations.sahih: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

translations.asad: [All this will be] a reward from thy Sustainer, a gift in accordance with [His Own] reckoning –
translations.sahih: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

text.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا

translations.asad: [a reward from] the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Most Gracious! [And] none shall have it in their power to raise their voices unto Him
translations.sahih: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا

translations.asad: on the Day when all [human] souls and all the angels will stand up in ranks: none will speak but he to whom the Most Gracious will have given leave; and [everyone] will say [only] what is right.
translations.sahih: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

text.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا

translations.asad: That will be the Day of Ultimate Truth: whoever wills, then, let him take the path that leads towards his Sustainer!
translations.sahih: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

text.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا

translations.asad: Verily, We have warned you of suffering near at hand - [suffering] on the Day when man shall [clearly] see what his hands have sent ahead, and when he who has denied the truth shall say, "Oh, would that I were mere dust...!"
translations.sahih: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
